Ýeral Web DS v0.6 · domain components · round 2

DS · Business patterns · v0.6

The domain components of business.yeral.app and yeral.app with every state, mapped to Feature-Sliced Design slices and Storybook titles. Round 6: free MVP (no billing), one Ýeral account with workspaces, fixed access levels, status icons everywhere, internal statuses, phone-first booking. Round 6 · part B: offered times after a decline, move requests, the SMS link page, hidden prices, phone-only clients, combined tables, the current-slot start. v0.6 round 1: English first — every word on the board is English (British, sentence case); people and business names stay as sample data; no average bill. v0.6 round 2 (first release = appointments only, no SMS promises): plain “Busy elsewhere” block, empty-slot menu + Block time, request timer that counts only while open, report menu + “Remove report”, the “Uses the app” switch instead of the phone-only level, business status banners, the “someone left” flow with AffectedBookingsList, invite and “Continue setting up” cards, sidebar without Reports / Help, addresses /w/{slug}/….

01Calendar02Requests & bookings03Clients04Team & services05Settings & onboarding06Reviews07Notifications08Analytics09Access & accounts10B2B landing · free11Tables12Classes13Client site14Phone · business app

Caption key — Name · FSD place · Storybook: new — Title | extend — Title: what | remove — Title · from: screens. Primitives (pills, banners, stat tiles, charts, copy field, settings row, save bar, number stepper, uploader, accordion) come from DS-Patterns and appear here only inside compositions. Retired in round 6: every billing component and the landing pricing (Ýeral Business is free on MVP), BranchCard, RoleEditor — listed in components-domain.md.

01 · Calendar

Resource grid, booking blocks, schedule layers and the legend

Everything the multi-staff calendar draws, round 6: every block starts with its status icon, requests are a solid pending fill with a dashed edge, cancelled is outline-only, selection is an ink ring, internal statuses are a small white chip, and a person busy in another workspace shows as “Busy elsewhere”. Round 2: busy elsewhere is a plain reserved block (label only), a free slot opens New booking · Block time, and blocks join the closed layer.

BookingBlock (MoveOriginal, MoveGhost, MoveLinked) · SlotCell (CurrentSlot) · entities/booking/ui/booking-block · entities/booking/model/move-request · widgets/calendar-grid/model/slot-now · Storybook: extend — Business/Calendar/BookingBlock: MoveOriginal, MoveGhost, MoveGhostSelected, MoveLinkedHover; extend — Business/Calendar/ScheduleLayers: CurrentSlot; extend — Business/Calendar/Legend: MoveRequest · from: B-Calendar (panel = move-request), B-Mobile

A client’s move request never moves the booking until it is answered: the original block stays where it is (confirmed, line 3 “→ Sat 17 · 11:30?”, wide note in pending ink “New time requested: …”, request timer pill), and a ghost block sits at the asked time = a pending block (clock, dashed #dc8b0b) with “New time?” in the name slot, the client on line 2 and “from Fri 16 · 10:00” on line 3. Both open the same move-request drawer (section 02); hovering one rings both (0 0 0 2px #fff, 0 0 0 4px n-500). The ghost holds the asked slot for the hold time (other bookings see it as busy) and counts in “N requests”. Current slot (E3): staff may start a booking at the current 15-minute slot (11:20 → 11:15, tables 18:40 → 18:30); earlier slots today are disabled — no back-dated bookings on MVP.

Fields: Person (select; preselected = the clicked column) · Date and time (date button + From–To selects, 15-min steps) · Reason chips Training · Break · Personal · Other (radio; Other shows a short text field, ≤ 30 characters, which becomes the label “Closed · {text}”) · Repeat segmented Doesn’t repeat / Every day / Every week · Until (only when repeating; the caption counts the days it makes). Buttons Cancel · Block time. A block can’t cover a booking (also a waiting request): the times turn red and the error under them names the booking with a link “Open the booking”; Block time stays off until the time is free (for a repeat, the first day it hits is named). Saved blocks are ordinary closed layers: not bookable online or by staff, they show in the legend as “Closed time — with the reason”, and they never reach the client (clients just see no free time). Toast “Time blocked: {person} · {from–to} · {reason}” (+ “· every week until …”).

02 · Requests & bookings

Requests, booking rows, drawers and their modals

Daily work: answering requests inside the hold time, reading and acting on a booking, creating a manual booking. Same drawers open from the calendar, the bookings list, tables and classes. Round 2: the timer counts only while open (“Answer by 09:30 tomorrow” when closed), Report is a menu with “Remove report”, the bulk bar is Confirm · Decline · Export CSV, and no copy promises an SMS.

RequestHoldTimer · entities/booking/ui/hold-timer · entities/business/model/open-hours (timer clock) · Storybook: new — Business/Requests/HoldTimer (Pill, Inline, Banner, Hot); extend (round 2): Closed (Pill, Inline, Banner) · from: B-Calendar, B-Bookings, B-Mobile (request cards)

Round 2: the hold time counts only while the business is open. While open: the running timer (“18 min”), pending ink above 15 min, no-show ink at ≤ 15 min (always clock icon + number, never colour alone). While closed: no countdown — the pill shows the deadline instead (“by 09:30” on a block, “By 09:30 tomorrow” in tables and cards; title / aria “Answer by 09:30 tomorrow”); the drawer explains it. Example: a request at 20:40 after closing at 20:00 with a 30-min hold → the clock starts at 09:00 → answer by 09:30. The deadline never passes the visit start. At the deadline the booking becomes Cancelled with by = system (“No answer in time”) and the client is offered 3 other times (a move request is just dropped).

MoveRequestRow (BookingRow variant="move-request") · MoveRequestDrawer (BookingDrawer mode="move-request") · MoveRequestBox · entities/booking/ui/booking-row · widgets/booking-drawer · entities/booking/ui/move-request-box · features/answer-move-request · Storybook: extend — Business/Bookings/BookingRow: MoveRequest; extend — Business/Bookings/BookingDrawer: MoveRequest, MoveRequestBusy, MoveRequestViewOnly; new — Business/Requests/MoveRequestTag · from: B-Bookings (Requests tab), B-Calendar (panel = move-request), B-Mobile (request cards)

A move request is a request on a confirmed booking: it lives in the Requests tab and the “N requests” count, keeps the badge Confirmed and adds the dashed pending tag “Time change” (arrow-left-right; 12/16 line in the table). Time cell “Fri 16 · 10:00 →” + bold new time. Drawer: status line with the tag, hold timer (on expiry the request is dropped and the booking stays — no 3 alternatives here), the before / after rows (“Show” scrolls the calendar to each block; B-Bookings opens the calendar), fit line (free → completed ink; busy → pending ink and “Confirm the new time” disabled), client, details and the decision footer Decline / Confirm the new time. Answered under the same “Who answers requests?” rule as new requests (viewers get the read-only footer). Accept → the booking moves (toast “New time confirmed: Saturday, 17 October · 11:30 · the client is notified”); decline → DeclineRequestModal with the reason chips but without “Offer another time” (toast “New time declined · the booking stays at its time · the client sees the reason”), the client sees “The new time wasn’t accepted …”. The specialist never changes silently: the new time is for the same person.

“Report” in the booking drawer footer becomes a menu (it used to open the complaint modal straight away). No-show appears only from the visit’s start time (on a Confirmed booking that has started, or a Completed one); Came late · Rude behaviour · Other… any time on a Confirmed or Completed booking. Every report is saved to the client’s card (team-only) and counts towards the 2-no-show phone-only rule. Remove report: in the booking drawer for 7 days after the report (“You can remove it until 21 October”); a removed No-show goes back to Completed, other reports just disappear; caption “The client isn’t told.” After 7 days the box stays without the button. Same rights as “Mark no-shows and report”. Phone: the menu is a second bottom sheet with the same items.

NewBookingDrawer · ClientPhoneField · ClientMatchList · ServicePicker · StaffPicker · NearestSlots · SlotPicker · features/create-booking/ui/* · entities/client/ui/client-search-result · features/create-booking/model/nearest-slots · Storybook: new — Business/Bookings/NewBookingDrawer (PhoneEmpty, PrefixMatches, KnownClient, UnknownNumber, PhoneIncomplete, ByName, NearestSlots, SpecialistSelf, NoStaff, Ready, WalkIn, CurrentSlot) · from: B-Calendar, B-Bookings (“New booking”), B-Clients (“Save and book”), B-Mobile (sheet)

Order is phone → client → service → staff → “Nearest free times” → (Another date and time) → note → “Notify the client”. The phone field is first and focused; from 3 digits it lists prefix matches (max 3); at 8 digits a known client fills in (name, visits, alert note box) and an unknown number becomes “New client” with an optional name. “Search by name” switches to the old search list. Nearest chips = first 4 free starts in the next 14 days for everyone who does all chosen services (staff name added when no staff is picked), after hours, breaks, buffers and busy elsewhere; a chip sets day + time + staff. A Specialist books only herself (fixed card). Manual bookings save as Confirmed with source phone. Replaces the v0.4 search-first drawer. Round 6 · part B: a source switch on top (Segmented “Phone call” / “Walk-in”); walk-in jumps to today, the first start is the current slot (11:20 → 11:15 with a 15-min step), the nearest chips start there, “Notify the client” is off by default and the source saves as walk-in. Round 2: no SMS at the first release — the switch is “Notify the client” (they see it in My bookings). Today never offers a time before the current slot — no back-dated bookings on MVP (recording a past visit is later).

Routing: pending invite → InviteCard first (Accept / Decline; declining asks in place, the owner is told); expired (7 days) → “The invite has expired”; no workspace → “Create a business” (setup wizard from step 2, already signed in); 1+ workspaces → the last used one opens with a short “Opening Glow Studio…” screen (no picker); round 2: an unfinished setup → “Continue setting up Glow Studio” (step N of 8, progress, what’s done, “Continue” → /setup/{step}) — never the no-workspace card. Addresses carry no language: business.yeral.app/login, /setup/{step}. Errors use role="alert"; headings take focus on step change.

BookingFlow (mode="move") · MoveSummary · LockedServices · pages/booking (apps/web) · features/move-booking/model (rules) · widgets/booking-flow · entities/booking/ui/move-summary · Storybook: extend — Client/Booking/Flow: MoveStaff, MoveTime, MoveConfirmManual, MoveConfirmInstant, MoveSentManual, MoveSentInstant, SentPromise; new — Client/Booking/MoveSummary · from: Booking (mode = move), Mobile frame 13, Account-Bookings (“Move to another time”)

Only appointments move (tables / classes: section above). Title “Change the time” + code pill (Pill neutral), steps Specialist · Time · Confirm — no services step; services show as a locked summary (lock 18, ListRow Locked) with the caption. The current specialist is preselected and tagged “Current”; “Any specialist” is offered; people who don’t do the service are disabled. **Rule change — no silent specialist swap:** the time grid shows only the chosen specialist’s free times (or anyone’s with “Any specialist”), the booking keeps that person (today the code hands it to another free specialist). The old time is not a choice in the grid. Confirm = ChangeSummary bar “Previous time → New time” (old struck at an instant business); manual → “Request the new time” + caption, sent screen “Time change request sent” (badge Confirmed + pending line); instant → “Change the time”, sent “Time changed”. Moving follows the free-change window (up to 2 hours before). The book-mode sent screen of a manual business adds the promise (15 = typicalConfirm, 30 = hold time).

MyBookingRow (+ OfferedTimes, MoveRequestLine, UndoFailedLine) · features/take-offered-time · features/undo-cancel · entities/booking/ui/my-booking-row · features/take-offered-time/ui/offer-chips · features/undo-cancel/ui · Storybook: extend — Client/Account/BookingRow: DeclinedWithOffers, OfferTaken, ExpiredWithOffers, OffersPassed, OfferTook, MoveWaiting, UndoFailed, CancelledBy (User, Business, Declined, Unanswered); new — Client/Account/OfferedTimes (Declined, Unanswered, Taken, Confirm, ConfirmSheet) · from: Account-Bookings (list), Mobile frames 7–10, 12

Three who-cancelled lines everywhere a cancelled booking shows (row, drawer, link page): user “You cancelled” · building “The business declined” (request declined) / “The business cancelled” (after confirm) · hourglass “No answer in time”; the badge stays Cancelled (x). The asked time is struck (n-500). Offers sit in a full-width strip under the row (grid-column 2 / −1): label “Offered times” or the unanswered lead sentence, max 3 slot chips (40, TimeSlots Offered), a taken chip is disabled + struck + “Already taken”. A chip opens the confirm (Back / Book); taking a declined offer creates the booking Confirmed at once (YR-48231), taking an unanswered one sends a new request (YR-48242, Pending; Confirmed at an instant business); the old row moves to Past with the link “… → YR-…”. When every offer is past the row moves to Past with calendar-x “The offered times have passed” + “Pick another time”. A waiting move keeps the badge Confirmed and adds the pending-ink clock line. Undo failed = greyed row (photo .5) + danger line with “Pick another time”; “Undo” is gone after 5 minutes.

MyBookingDrawer (client) · MoveRequestBox · BookingTimeline · widgets/my-booking-drawer · entities/booking/ui/move-request-box · entities/booking/ui/status-timeline · features/move-booking · features/cancel-booking (client) · Storybook: extend — Client/Account/BookingDrawer: DeclinedWithOffers, MoveWaiting, MoveDeclined, MoveUnanswered, FixedTime (table / class), CancelWithMove, MoveAgain; extend — Client/Account/BookingTimeline: Declined, MoveAsked · from: Account-Bookings (drawer, cancel modal), Mobile frames 10–11

Declined head = StatusBadge + 17/24 who-cancelled line with its icon + reason caption, then the business note box (n-100), the same OfferedTimes, a two-step timeline (Request sent → The business declined · reason) and one secondary “Pick another time”. A waiting move adds the pending box (#fef6e7 / #f2ddb0 — DS-Patterns Callout pending with the inline “from → to”), its caption and a danger-ghost “Withdraw request”; the timeline gains “New time requested” (now marker). Declined or unanswered move → the box goes, a neutral note says the booking stays (+ reason when declined); accepted → the booking moves, toast / SMS “New time confirmed: …”; an instant business moves at once (“Time changed”). Tables and classes never show “Move to another time”: footer “Cancel booking” + “Book again” (opens Booking-Table prefilled with party + area, or the same class) and the rule line without “or change”. Cancelling with a waiting move adds “The time change request will be withdrawn too.”; a second move replaces the first (“Your earlier request (Saturday, 11:30) will be replaced by the new one.”).

BookingLinkCard · LinkLogin · pages/booking-link (apps/web) · widgets/booking-link-card · features/take-offered-time · features/auth-by-phone/ui/masked-phone-step · Storybook: new — Client/BookingLink/Card (Declined, DeclinedPicked, Unanswered, Confirmed, Pending, MoveWaiting, OffersPassed, NotFound, Success), Client/BookingLink/Login (MaskedPhone, Code, CodeWrong) · from: Booking-Link (new page), Mobile frames 14–15, SMS templates (link in every request / decline / move SMS)

One card (max 480, drawn 400; r16, n-200 line, photo 168 → 132 here) on a logo-only header, no account chrome. Order: business name + category · address, service · specialist, asked time (struck when cancelled), StatusBadge + who-cancelled line + reason, business note box, offers. Picking a chip opens the login inside the card (no modal): the phone is prefilled and masked “+993 65 •• •• 22” (read-only n-50 box with lock — only the booking’s owner can receive the code; there is no “Change number”), “Send code” → four code boxes (56) + 59 s resend → success (YR-48231 Confirmed, kv list, “Go to my bookings” + “Add to calendar”). Confirmed / pending links are read-only (Address, Phone, Price + “Directions” / “Call”; cancel or move only in My bookings). Unknown or expired link = EmptyState page (“This link doesn’t work”). Footer n-50 “Booking code”. The full phone number never reaches the signed-out page (the server masks it).

A day may end at 24:00 (pickers 06:00–24:00 on the business side): “09:00–24:00” in the hours table, “Open now · until 24:00” in the header; open past midnight stays undesigned. While a business is “In review”, visitors at the link get the friendly page (EmptyState page size, hourglass in an a-50 circle, one way out to Search, HTTP 404 + noindex, no business details); the owner and team see their own page with the pending banner (no dismiss).
